# KafkaControllerElectionsFlapping

<!-- GENERATED by monitoring/dashgen from internal/rules (make alerts). Do not edit. -->

| Severity | Component | Dashboard | for (production / demo) |
|---|---|---|---|
| warning | kafka | [kafka-kraft](http://grafana.localhost:8080/d/kafka-kraft/) | 5m / 0s |

**Summary:** KRaft controller of cluster <kafka_cluster> changed more than twice in 15 minutes

Frequent controller elections pause metadata changes each time. Typical causes: GC pauses or CPU starvation on controller nodes, network flakiness, slow metadata log disks.

## Impact

Every election pauses metadata processing; partition leadership changes are delayed.

## Diagnosis

1. Kafka · JVM: GC pauses on controller nodes longer than controller.quorum.fetch.timeout.ms?
2. Kafka · Pods & Nodes: CPU throttling or I/O pressure on controller nodes.

## Mitigation

- Give controller nodes dedicated, unthrottled resources; separate controller and broker roles on bigger clusters.

## Expression

```promql
max by (kafka_cluster) (delta(kafka_controller_kafkacontroller_newactivecontrollerscount[15m])) > 2
```
